axis_mapping.advanced_remap: none; fit scale+bias on loader gz only

calibration_provenance.feature_timing: true GPS orientation changes; gyro averaged over identical intervals
calibration_provenance.lag_selection: training portion of prefix only, -1.0..+1.0 s at 0.1 s
calibration_provenance.mapped_yaw_scale: [0.85, 1.15], consistent with loader rad/s sensor contract
calibration_provenance.ood_radius: empirical 99.5% Mahalanobis quantile on held-out prefix ticks

protocol: prefix-only calibration; forced outage GNSS held out for scoring; same known-route prior for both methods
known_route_caveat: route geometry is built from the full logged drive as a stand-in for an offline OSM/fleet map; no outage positions enter the calibrator

summary.pass_rule: median final error improves and empirical coverage >= 85%
